access_modes.label: Default
access_modes.description: Runs in the workspace-write sandbox. Codex asks you to review command, network, or file access when approval is needed.

access_modes.label: Full Access
access_modes.description: Disables sandboxing and approval prompts. Codex can run commands and access files or network without asking first.

access_modes.label: Auto Review
access_modes.description: Keeps the workspace-write sandbox, but lets Codex automatically review approval requests instead of routing each one to you.
